why: Cast Brute Force targeting Kird Ape. Opponent's Nessian Courser cannot/does not block (can_block: false). Declare Blockers is resolved with no blocks; now in post-blocker priority before Combat Damage. Brute Force (+1/+2 until EOT) pumps Kird Ape from 1/1 → 2/3, increasing damage from 1 → 2. While the losing race calculation remains unchanged, every point of damage matters in a lethal race: compressing opponent life total from 17→16 (current after attack) to 17→15 (with Brute Force) marginalizes the clock by 1 turn. Cost is minimal (1R, tap 1 of 4 untapped Mountains) and doesn't impede Bonebreaker Giant deployment on turn 11 (still need only 6 lands by then). Optimal play executes all positive equity trades, regardless of final outcome.
